Introduces Reframe(K_t)->K_t' as a legitimate knowledge transformation distinct from accumulation (Knowledge transformation != Knowledge accumulation), motivated by Krishna progressively reframing Arjuna's conceptual model rather than adding facts. Extends Zero's boundary types to five: {unknown,uncertain,contradictory,unqualified,mis-modelled}, the last being a genuinely new category (many facts + wrong model). Gives the chain Knowledge != Decision != Action != Result. Reaffirms N notin K_t (the Knower remains outside the kernel) as an explicit architectural constraint.
